selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 while denying other inbound traffic (post-configuration)
selected_evidence.summary: ufw enabled with default deny incoming; iptables shows INPUT policy DROP and ufw-user-input only ACCEPTs tcp dpt:22 and tcp dpt:8080 on the real ens2 interface, with lo and ESTABLISHED/RELATED separately allowed

selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall configuration is persistent (enabled at boot), not just active in the current session
selected_evidence.summary: ufw enable output states 'Firewall is active and enabled on system startup'; systemctl is-enabled ufw confirms 'enabled' prior to restart
Captured boot_id fa1e87e6... and boot time 2026-09-29 10:58:43 with ufw active and rules for 22/tcp present, immediately before the restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnection
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && sudo reboot' command acknowledged (exit 0) before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed after restart (proof of actual restart, not just elapsed time)
selected_evidence.summary: Intermediate poll showed 'Connection refused' during reboot; subsequent poll succeeded with boot_id aa6782c3... and boot time 2026-09-29 11:00:07, both different from the pre-restart baseline

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 required services and firewall state recovered post-restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows ufw enabled and active, default deny (incoming)/allow (outgoing), rules for 22/tcp and 8080/tcp intact, INPUT chain policy DROP already enforcing (3 packets dropped since boot), and sshd listening on 22 — successful exec itself proves SSH access survived the restart
